programme.title: The Rapping Politician & The 90's Rap Icon
programme.desc: Matchmaker Patti Stanger takes on the most challenging clients of her lifetime and this week is no exception. Former politician and current rapper Shawn Isaac aka “Shawn Don” checks in with an unrealistic wish list based on credentials rather than chemistry. He hasn't dated seriously in four years and dumped his only girlfriend because she didn't meet his “resume requirements”. Patti gives Shawn a much-needed love lesson and discovers some shocking information that helps explain Shawn's logistical rather than emotional mindset when it comes to love. But Shawn has a huge secret that could change everything… Meanwhile, 90's Grammy nominated music icon, Monie Love, has to control everything in her universe. At 46 years old, she's feeling the pressure to find Mr. Right and settle down but her micromanaging habits are blocking any chance she has at finding love. Patti discovers Monie's controlling ways stem from her childhood and that deep-rooted behavior brings out the worst in the men she dates. Patti's mission is to transform Monie from an overbearing alpha into a softer, gentler beta, but that winds up being much harder than expected. Will either Shawn or Monie take Patti's advice and find love or will they break her rules and check out of the Millionaire's Club alone?

programme.title: Bad Boy Magnet and The Insta-Ham
programme.desc: This week at the Millionaire's Club, matchmaker Patti Stanger faces off against Tiffany Foxx, a sexy rap artist and star of “Love and Hip Hop.” Tiffany has a type…bad boys, and her 14-year long relationship was with a man who spent 9 of those years in prison! As predicted, Tiffany fails her love lesson and Patti begins to realize that the problem goes deeper, into childhood. An emotional Tiffany finally recognizes she needs to change. But when Patti throws a test into her mingle, will Tiffany revert to type or reach for true love with a good guy? At the same time, Patti and her team take on Christopher Lourdes, who spends his days posting on Instagram. He uses the social media site to flash his wealth and meet women who are only after one thing…his wallet. Patti needs to put the brakes on his social media frenzy and show him that he's only attracting “Instawhores.” A resistant Christopher finally agrees to try things Patti's way but backslides horribly endangering his possibilities to check out with his date. Both Patti's clients this week need to choose their paths wisely. If they don't, Tiffany and Christopher will leave the club alone.

programme.title: Mr. Hit It And Quit It and The Baywatch Babe
programme.desc: If you think Patti Stanger has faced her toughest clients, you ain't seen nothing yet. When Candace brings in her good friend Marcellas Reynolds, a gay celebrity stylist with a bigger than life personality, Patti certainly has her hands full. Marcellas likes to “hit it and quit it” and never gets beyond surface looks with his partners. But when he miserably fails his love lesson, Patti makes him face his behavior resulting in an explosive moment you'd never expect. Realizing there's more going on than meets the eye, Patti tells Marcellas that he needs to go deeper and be vulnerable with others if he wants a chance at true love. At the same time, Donna D'Errico, a Baywatch babe formerly married to Nikki Sixx from Motley Crue, is back on the dating scene for the first time since her difficult divorce. Soon to be an empty nester, Donna needs Patti's guidance to have fun again and stop assuming men will disappoint her. Both Patti's clients have built walls to protect themselves and she and her team have to go into ninja matchmaker mode to break them down. And if Marcellas and Donna don't follow Patti's rules and open themselves to the possibilities out there, they'll go home alone.

programme.title: Crazy Kelly & The Desperate Housewife
programme.desc: 3rd Generation matchmaker Patti Stanger is back and better than ever. She's taken over an exclusive boutique hotel where she takes on the toughest cases she's ever seen. This week, Patti has two Real Housewives check in: Liar Magnet Claudia Jordan from Atlanta and “Crazy” Kelly Bensimon from New York. Patti helps Kelly get over her nasty reality TV reputation and see that her insecurity is all in her head. Claudia goes deep with Patti, and exposes her traumatic experiences with men that lead her to attract all the wrong men. Patti goes to extreme measures to get Claudia to thoroughly vet guys to find her Mr. Right. It's time to call the man who Claudia needs to confront in order to move on and find true love. Patti and her team gather the best of the best for a sexy all-male mingle where the housewives get their pick of the litter. The Housewives choose their dates, but will Claudia vet her date enough (or too much) and will Kelly keep the “crazy” away? At the end of the week, will these Housewives take their lessons to heart and go home crazy in love or will they check out alone?

programme.title: Mr. Self-Absorbed & The Trainwreck
programme.desc: Patti Stanger has never met clients who challenge her as much as the two this week. TV star Courtney Stodden is only 22 years-old but she's been in the media eye since she was 16, when she controversially married a 50-year-old actor. Now single, Courtney is making up for lost time by partying like a rockstar! Is Courtney straight, bi-sexual or gay, she's not sure so Patti preps for her first ever bi-sexual mingle. What we do know is that Courtney hates rules, she hates being told what to do and she hates keeping her clothes on. Patti is tasked with trying to tame this wild child who is mentally a rebellious 16-year-old, but to do so Patti is forced to use extreme measures. Meanwhile, MMA fighter Shondo Blades checks in with a huge chip on his shoulder and a strong need to be the center of attention. His excuse for having three kids with two women and never married is that women can't keep up with him. But during the love lesson, Patti checks him by pointing out he's a self-absorbed one man show that leaves no room for a co-star. And to add insult to injury, a commitment phoebe. Pissed at the truth, Shondo threatens to leave the Millionaire's Club and tensions explode. Can Patti find a way to break through to her combative clients or will their extreme behaviors sabotage their search for love?

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S2E37
programme.desc: Samantha's Aunt Clara arrives on the Stephens' first anniversary with presents for Samantha and Darrin. Casting a spell to adjust a checkered cap she has given Darrin, Aunt Clara uses the wrong words and turns Darrin into a chimpanzee. Unable to remember how to remove the spell, Aunt Clara goes home to look for the formula. When Samantha leaves the house, Endora stays with Darrin. Darrin leaps out of a window and runs into Gladys Kravitz. She takes the chimp back to her house. Soon after, Aunt Clara comes with her book of magic, Samantha returns. Samantha tells Aunt Clara she must find Darrin since her doctor has told her she is going to have a baby. Meanwhile, Gladys and Abner have turned Darrin over to the zoo, where he is caged with three other chimps. Samantha goes to the zoo. Then Aunt Clam arrives and turns Darrin back to his former self. Samantha is finally able to tell him he is to be a father. Later, Gladys begins telling the Stephens about the chimpanzee. Suddenly realizing that Darrin is wearing the same outfit as the chimp, Gladys streaks back to her own house.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S2E38
programme.desc: Learning that he is about to become a father, Darrin waits on Samantha hand and foot. Then Larry Tate convinces him that all women would make a career out of having a baby if you allowed them to. He gives Darrin a book on the subject which states that the more active the mother, the happier she will be, and the healthier the child. Darrin returns home completely convinced. Endora is infuriated when she hears Darrin ordering Samantha to do chores around the house. The following day, Darrin wakes up with a backache. At an office lunch, he fights for extra pickles. When Samantha learns of this, she faces up to her mother. Endora admits she has cast a spell over Darrin, but will do nothing to change the situation for the present. Darrin, dis-cussing his plight at a bar, becomes obsessed with the idea that he is going to have a baby himself. Finally, Endora removes the spell and Darrin becomes completely attentive to Samantha once more. She agrees with Darrin's assertion that he is one man in a million who knows just how she feels.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S2E39

programme.desc: When strange things begin happening to Adam Newlarkin, a friend of Darrin's, Aunt Clara tells Samantha he has inherited the spell placed by a witch on his ancestor who was a judge in Salem two hundred years before. Aunt Clara adds that unless Adam follows the antidote for the spell strictly, he will be branded a thief. The Stephens learn that Adam has been hired by a local bank. Samantha and Darrin manage to get Adam to kiss a dog, the first step. With Aunt Clara's help, Darrin dunks Adam in a pool three times. They have trouble persuading him to ride through town shouting praise of witches, which is the final step. However, finding his briefcase stuffed with money , Adam, a true native of Salem, believes he is under a spell. He mounts a horse and starts riding. Bank manager Abercrombie and a detective, having discovered the loss of seventy five thousand dollars, come to the Stephens' home. Aunt Clara makes the money disappear from the briefcase. Abercrombie apologizes to Adam after learning that a bank employee has been taken into custody with the stolen cash.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: The Power of Plants Race to Grow and Breed
programme.desc: Just like animals, the lives of plants are dominated by the need to become strong and pass on genes to the next generation – a race to grow and breed. They must race to beat their competition to the best light spots, and to make the most of perilously short seasons. And also like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Our ideas about plants need a seed change – it's time to respect the power of plants.

programme.title: Tundra
programme.desc: What at first it can seem an icy wasteland, the tundra is actually a tapestry of interconnected life creatures relying on one another to survive the long winter.

programme.title: Wonderful Wetlands
programme.desc: Water is the key to life. It provides a haven for countless plants and animals, everything from water-loving cats and predatory birds to killer dragonflies and carnivorous foliage. It can be a nursery, a migration stopover and a larder. And there's place where water is gathered, drained and stored for all to enjoy – the wetland. Wetlands are some of the most remarkable ecosystems in the natural world everything from dragonflies and bats to fish and amphibians can thrive thanks to the wonderful wetland.

programme.title: Europe's Wilderness
programme.desc: This episode is about on the most ancient and majestic animal of the continent: the muskox seems like the last survivor of the ice age – and it is. Thousands of years ago the animals roamed our landscapes together with mammoths. Nowadays, the only remaining herds live in Scandinavia: the Dovrefjell National Park in Norway and the Härjedaalen area in Sweden - where scientists and environmentalists put up a breeding centre in order to protect and strengthen the wild population of muskox - are the main locations of this episode.

programme.title: World's Rarest
programme.desc: The world is facing an urgent biodiversity crisis. Untold numbers of animals are at risk of being lost forever, with many species racing towards extinction. In this show, we try to highlight some of these incredible creatures, from the plucky pangolins to the critically endangered rhinoceroses, who live in constant fear of the poacher's bullet. Films provide a record of Earth's wonderful wildlife, but this is hopefully not an archive of what's lost, but evidence of what we should be preserving.

programme.title: Endagered with Michaela Strachen
programme.desc: Seeks to find the rare and endangered species of South Africa and establish what we need to do to conserve them. Documenting and recording the status of our endangered species by region.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble. And they're not just stealthy, they're also some of the most enigmatic and beautiful creatures on the planet.

programme.title: The Power of Plants The Great Escape
programme.desc: You think plants are boring or passive? Far from it! They use complex reactions to respond to light, sound and touch. And like in the animal kingdom, different species have developed a near unending list of strategies to ensure their legacy is passed on. Plants have evolved tricks to beat the ele-ments, animal enemies or even other plants: From thorns and spines to poisons and even live-in bodyguards. This two-part series shows the survival strategies of our green “roommates” we share the planet with.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: The island of Martinique is a piece of France in the Caribbean, between Florida and South America. And of course, Savoir-vivre applies just as it does on the other side of the Atlantic, between the English Channel and the Mediterranean. Jacky Pascault is the first and only man to cultivate mushrooms in the Caribbean. Everywhere else, they grow on artificially fertilised soil, but Jacky's Champignons Tropicaux flourish on sugar cane fibres. Nicole Vilo tailors hats and dresses out of coconut palms. Of course, the catwalk for the models wearing her first collection is one of the countless dream beaches. The Martiniquais sail on boats they call Yole, which have no keel and are therefore difficult to navigate. The crew members hang over the water in breakneck fashion on long wooden poles. Just the job for Yole-boss Max' "problem kids": they not only learn complicated handling, but also team spirit.

programme.title: glCuba
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world's ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn's house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver's personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: The Heart of Hawaii
programme.desc: The Oahu island is the economic and cultural centre of the Hawaiian archipelago, as well as being a paradise for surfers, active holidaymakers and freedom lovers. The island is home to more than half of all natives and almost eight million foreign guests annually. Anyone searching for peace and seclusion won't find either in Honolulu or Waikiki. Traffic congestion and a backdrop of skyscrapers belong to the town panorama. Hip cafes, galleries and young fashion firms have settled here, adding a new and modern flair to the capital. Cindy's Lei Shoppe, the Chinatown florists, has been here for more than 30 years. This is also because the so-called Leis, the tradition of floral decoration, usually offered as a flower necklace or as a headdress, is still an important part of Hawaiian culture. Keone Nunes is well-known for his traditional tattooing skills, whereby the so-called Kakau Tattoos are virtually hammered into the skin with a hippo tooth. But Oahu is also an island of overwhelming natural beauty and a fascinating diversity on the smallest of places ...

programme.title: The Seychelles
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars, toilet paper, horses, bicycles, furniture - you name it, the Espoir transports goods of all kinds. Coconuts sometimes pose a problem as there are far too many of them. What to do with them? The best place to send them is undoubt-edly Hubert Roumien's Virgin Coconut Oil Laboratory, hidden away in the Mahé jungle. Straw turns into gold at Seaweed Seychelles! There, Benjamin Port Louis collects seaweed and extracts liquid fertiliser from it.

programme.title: Sri Lanka
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.sub-title: The Caribbean for explorers: St. Vincent and the Grenadines
programme.desc: Much more Caribbean than on the islands of St. Vincent and the Grenadines is hardly possible. Deserted beaches, uninhabited islands, lush vegetation, the 33 islands in total are dreamlike with extremely hospitable inhabitants. Miranda Phillips runs a laundry and water boat on Bequia. Every morning, the 32-year-old navigates from yacht to yacht with her small bright green service vehicle and is already expected by most skippers. programme.title: To the South
programme.desc: At the first part of his journey, the photographer is lucky to get some shots of rare animal species. Between the gaps of the rocky mountains he traces funny creatures: Pica. They look like a mixture between hamsters and rabbits. From his hideout Benny Rebel manages to observe impressive Ibexes, a kind of wild goats with huge horns. Equipped with a special microcopter and night shot camera traps he tries to get a sneak into the life of shy inhabitants of the steppe. In his adventure he encounters lonesome dromedary herds and discovers a spooky cave of hyenas. Rebel witnesses owls, snakes and lizards living between the antique ruins of the old Persian capital Persepolis. Benny Rebel also is interested in the relationship between men and nature. He meets not only ranger in the wild, but also visitors of the magnificent Persian gardens in the middle of rough deserts. Between the fountains of freshly sputtering water pelicans take a bath. Young and old people walk in the green paradises in front of attractive mosques. Unexpected the 43 year old photographer meets animal lovers on the roof tops of urban houses. The bet on the flying skills of their specific breed of pigeons. And like a house from a fairy tale seem the historical pigeon towers with their unique architecture housing more than ten thousands of birds. Finally Benny Rebel traces an Asiatic cheetah in the semi desert. Less than a hundred of the big cats are left in the wild. The nature conservationist and photographer decides to come closer to the dangerous carnivore.

programme.title: Life on the Amber Coast
programme.desc: The wide, often untouched wilderness of the Baltic hinterland is home to many animals. More than 35 brown bears live in the primeval forests of Alutaguse. In the spring, the Soomaa National Park transforms into a huge lake.

programme.title: Between Estonia and Finland
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest ocean in the world and first evolved after the last Ice Age. We think we know everything about it, yet still it has many surprises in store. Wind and waves still shape the shores of the Baltic Sea. The second episode presents a world comprising tens of thousands of islands, between Estonia, Gotland in Sweden and the Finnish Archipelago Sea. In the Autumn on Saaremaa, the largest Estonian island, nasal sounds can be heard from one corner to the next: The mating calls of the Moose. Huge bulls make their way to the traditional rutting areas in the south of the island. The landscape here is stony and riddled with countless bays. In the north, the Panga Cliff, a limestone wall of some 20 metres in height and more than 400 million years old. In the beginning of March, animal filmmaker Christoph Hauschild and his team accompany two seal researchers going about their work. Their destinations are two small islands in the Bay of Riga. A popular spot for grey seals. This is the first time that a film team has been allowed on the island. Just how many animals there are, can first be seen from the air. The beach is packed with young seals. The largest gathering in the Baltic Sea. The absence of pack ice forces the mothers to come here. Global warming has visibly changed the Baltic Sea as far as the Bay of Riga. The winters are simply too hot for the well-insulated young seals. So as not to overheat, they take dips in the cooling water. The underwater camera captures intimate moments and reveals just how playfully the youngsters enjoy the cool water. Just 200 kilometres to the west lies an ancient coral reef, Gotland. The Swedish island is like an ark in the central Baltic Sea. Much of the flora and fauna one otherwise only finds in Southern Europe can be found here on the second largest island in the Baltic Sea. Golden eagles breed here in the trees and in the spring, the ground is covered in orchids. 35 different varieties grow on Gotland.

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. programme.title: The Lallantop
programme.desc: Nepal's flood tragedy has raised serious concerns about India's preparedness for similar Himalayan disasters, with Uttarakhand, UP, and Bihar on high alert as rivers rise. The show also covers the Ayodhya Ram Temple CEO selection and the Bombay High Court ordering a CBI probe into Disha Salian's death.

programme.title: Duniyadari
programme.desc: Nepal has named China, India and the US as major emitters and demanded climate compensation for its devastating floods that killed 1,127 people. PM Balen Shah will press the demand at the UNGA, while the US launched deadly attacks on Iran, triggering retaliation against Gulf nations.

programme.title: Kharcha Pani
programme.desc: PM Modi has renewed his appeal to avoid buying gold unless necessary, as gold imports surged 32% to $15.17 billion in the first four months of the fiscal year . The government doubled import duty to 15% in May, but gold prices remain near record highs at over ₹1.56 lakh per 10 grams .

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi, Congress leader Imran Pratapgarhi, and the Samajwadi Party are competing for Muslim voters in Uttar Pradesh. The battle has intensified after former AIMIM spokesperson Wasim Waqar joined the Congress, accusing Owaisi of "personal glorification" over community issues.

programme.title: Sehat
programme.desc: Sehat | In this episode, we discuss why food keeps getting stuck between your teeth, when children may need therapy and which vegetables people with diabetes should eat in moderation.

programme.title: UP Bulletin
programme.desc: Uttar Pradesh is facing a fresh flood and waterlogging crisis as rivers rise across 17 districts, affecting thousands in Varanasi, Ballia, Prayagraj, and Chitrakoot. CM Yogi launched the UPCOS digital integration initiative for outsourced employees, while a Mainpuri DSP's angry reaction to people recording him has sparked attention.

programme.title: The Cinema Show
programme.desc: Netflix has announced The One About Matthew Perry documentary series, while Yash's Toxic faces an unexpected box office challenge from a ₹2 crore film . We also cover Mirzapur: The Movie crossing ₹3.7 crore in advance bookings and the clash between Rashmika Mandanna's Mysaa and Emraan Hashmi's Gunmaaster G9.

programme.title: Aasan Bhasha Mein
programme.desc: How are some Indian Instagram creators earning lakhs every month through paid subscriptions? We break down Instagram's subscription model, follower and subscriber patterns, pricing and estimated earnings of popular creators.

programme.title: Tarikh
programme.desc: How did reservation in India begin, and what role did Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj play in shaping Dr. B.R. Ambedkar's journey? This episode traces the history of reservation, from Shahu Maharaj's 1902 policy to the Poona Pact and Constituent Assembly debates.

programme.title: Sciencekaari
programme.desc: Sciencekaari | In this episode, we explain ISRO's EOS-05 mission and how its geosynchronous orbit could transform Earth observation. The satellite is designed to provide continuous monitoring of a large region from nearly 36,000 km above Earth.

programme.title: Zero Cricket Knowledge
programme.desc: Pakistan has made sweeping changes ahead of the third Test against England, dropping seven players—including Mohammad Rizwan and Imam-ul-Haq—and sacking head coach Sarfaraz Ahmed and bowling coach Umar Gul . The overhaul comes after two heavy defeats, with five uncapped players called up and Babar Azam retaining the captaincy .

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: In this video, we report on unusual and unidentified fish being spotted in the Gandak River near Bihar's West Champaran after the Nepal floods. Authorities have advised people not to catch, sell or eat the fish until their safety is confirmed.

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: In this video, we explain why former IAS officer Ashish Joshi was questioned by Delhi Police over a controversial social media post. He was later released, while a case was reportedly registered under BNS Section 192.

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: In this video, we explain the growing diplomatic tension around PM Narendra Modi's meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and the US reaction. Marco Rubio has warned countries against helping Iran bypass American sanctions.

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: In this video, we bring you the heartbreaking stories of Nepal flood victims' families who are performing symbolic last rites for loved ones still missing. At Pashupatinath, families are using effigies to say goodbye while rescue teams continue the search.

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: Dozens of women queued at a school sheltering Nepal flood victims, jostling for personal-care supplies as sanitation and menstrual hygiene concerns mount. While aid groups have provided shelter and food, women in Nuwakot camps face inadequate toilets and unsanitary conditions.

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: Bihar is reeling from a severe flood and erosion crisis as the Ganga, Son, Gandak, and Kosi rivers breach danger marks at 10 locations . programme.desc: In Devighat, the local mosque imam shares what residents have faced after the devastating floods. He speaks about the situation, the challenges, and whether government assistance has reached the community.

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI FROM SACHKHAND SRI HARMANDIR SAHIB, AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.31
programme.desc: Tailing Hwa-ryeong's men from the merchant guild, Taedo discovers the kiln where Jeongi is being held. Seizing a brief opening as soldiers pass by, he rescues Jeongi and flees with her—only to be struck by a throwing blade. Face to face with Gangcheon, Jeongi unleashes her fury, declaring that she can never forgive him for being her father. Steeling her resolve, Jeongi immerses herself in the potter's wheel and presents the finished vessel to King Seonjo.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.32
programme.desc: With the Bunwon seized by Japanese forces, Jeongi attempts to slip away to meet Gwanghae but is captured by Gangcheon. After learning the full truth from Mun Saseung, Yukdo agonizes over his choice—then ultimately releases Jeongi. Trusting that Gwanghae will drive the invaders away, Jeongi returns to the Bunwon and waits for his promise to be fulfilled.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.1
programme.desc: Hyung Joon tries to launch a cosmetics business with the help of his wealthy friend Yoon, but Yoon refuses. Hong Sam suggests they save the company by creating a Miss Korea. Meanwhile, Hyung Joon seeks out Oh Ji Young, who was the queen bee in his high school days.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.2
programme.desc: Yoon promises to fully support ViVi Cosmetics if their Miss Korea wins, so Hyung Joon, Hong Sam, and Kang Woo search for beautiful women they know. Ji Young takes Director Ma's business card and visits Queen Beauty Salon.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.3
programme.desc: Under Director Ma's guidance, Jae Hee undergoes special training to become Miss Korea, satisfying Director Ma with her excellent skills. Oh Ji Young and Kim Hyung Joon decide to participate in the Miss Korea pageant with different motives, first preparing for the 'Mandarin Lady Pageant'. Director Ma attends the 'Mandarin Lady Pageant' as a judge, where Ji Young is scheduled to compete.

programme.title: Miss Korea Ep.4
programme.desc: Yoon offers Ji Young to be her 'sponsor', and Ji Young leaves in indignation and a sense of betrayal towards Hyung Joon. Teacher Jung tries to get money from Hyung Joon's mother but is flustered by her formidable demeanor. After many twists and turns, Ji Young steps onto the stage for the 'Mandarin Lady Pageant'.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.desc: A sizzling take on barbecue traditions where spice rubs, char, and glaze create rich flavor. Each dish delivers juicy tenderness and smoky depth, creating that familiar BBQ spirit and crowd-pleasing comfort.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Chocolate on the barbecue? That's right. Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode as he grills a crispy coconut-cacao crust and serves it with sweet chili dipping sauce. Chocolate is the not-so-secret ingredient in Spencer's Grilled Chicken Molé. He grills the chicken legs smothered in the sweet-spicy-salty-nutty-creamy-chocolatey sauce, then finishes it by cooking it slow and low. Next, dark chocolate cocoa powder is in both the rub and the sauce for Chef Watts' favourite pork rib recipe - Cocoa-rubbed Baby Back Ribs. For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate crumble over the top.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: In this bacon loving episode, Chef Spencer delivers a tasty Bacon Weave Turkey Breast, which gets injected with beer and spices before being wrapped up in its cozy bacon blanket and sent off to the grill! Next up? A Peameal Bacon Roast with Rosti. This heavy hunk of back bacon gets smoked to flavourful perfection while Chef Watts makes the crispiest golden-fried-to-perfection potato pancake. Then, Spencer whips up a charry, grilled, super decadent, bacon-wrapped and bacon stuffed cheeseburger. Spencer isn't finished with bacon yet! For his final recipe, Spencer stuffs an apple with decadent crispy morsels stuffed along with savoury caramelized onions and melty cheddar cheese.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: This episode kicks off with Spencer's tasty Grilled Caesar Salad. He skillfully piles of char-grilled romaine lettuce wedges and sourdough croutons are topped with tangy dressing, crispy pancetta, and shards of a homemade parmesan tuile. For his next recipe, Spencer whips up Grilled Zucchini Boats that filled with fresh ingredients including orzo pasta, summer veggies, and herbs. Chef Watts loves a good steak and his Grilled Cauliflower Steak is not one to be passed up! Dusted in Middle Eastern Spices, flame roasted and served with chili-spiked, Yemeni 'Skhug' hot sauce and pomegranate seeds. Finally, Spencer steams tender artichokes, stuffing these flowers with breadcrumbs and stretchy-melty cheese, and finishes this delicious dish on the grill.

programme.title: Global Veggies

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates is television's best travel show that never leaves the kitchen. Skilled Chef Craig Wong is your host, and prepare to be blown away by his takes on the foods of France and Vietnam. First up? A re-write of a popular Vietnamese street snack made with Clams and Sesame Rice Noodles. Next? Marrow Toast dresses up in its tux and tails for a version made with King Oyster Mushrooms and Sauce Bordelaise. The common ingredient is Baguette check out supersonic versions of French Jambon Beurre and Vietnamese Banh Mi. The Big Dish blends delicate sole with ProvencÌ§ale flavour spiked Nuoc Cham and a crunchy Haricot Amandine inspired Vietnamese crepe.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Go-to Indian menu item Lamb Rogan Josh is one thing, but Lamb Sweetbreads Rogan Josh with Aloo Gobi Foam? That's a CombiNATION Plates thing! Craig Wong is at it again in this USA + India episode. After India, Chef moves on to the USA to answer the question, 'is everything better battered and fried?' with his Country Fried Torchon of Foie Gras. The common ingredient for these two distant nations is lobster, and really, who doesn't love it? For the US, it's Lobster with Cajun Spice Grits and Pickled Okra, and for India, check out Lobster Curry with Coconut Milk. The finale features Catfish like you've never seen it. Cooked Tandoori style and served with Collard Greens Paneer and Peach Bhaji, it's a one-of-a-kind CombiNATION sensation!

programme.desc: Un divo del muto cade in disgrazia con l'invenzione del sonoro. Verrà salvato dall'amore di una sua fan.L'evento in bianco e nero che ha conquistato Cannes.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: La storia dell'amore
programme.desc: C'era una volta un ragazzo, Léo, che amava una ragazza, Alma. Le aveva promesso che l'avrebbe fatta ridere per tutta la vita, ma la guerra li ha separati. Da un paesino della Polonia negli anni Trenta alla New York dei giorni nostri ripercorriamo la straordinaria storia d'amore tra Léo, l'uomo che è sopravvissuto a tutto e Alma, la donna più amata del mondo. Oggi un'altra Alma, adolescente newyorchese e contagiata dallo stesso virus meraviglioso dell'amore, vuole essere la donna più amata del mondo. Sembra che niente leghi Léo alla giovane Alma ma… L'amore attraverserà il tempo e i continenti per unire i loro destini.

programme.title: Non ti posso dimenticare
programme.desc: Fred Astaire impersona un eroico pilota della seconda guerra mondiale innamorato di una dattilografa la quale, ignara del suo valore, lo disprezza credendolo un imboscato. Alla fine la donna scoprirà la verità.

programme.title: Monster Family 2
programme.desc: Nuova avventura animata per la valorosa famiglia di mutanti. Per salvare i loro cari e sconfiggere una perfida cacciatrice, i Wishbone sono costretti a trasformarsi di nuovo in mostri.

programme.title: Argonuts – Missione Olimpo
programme.desc: Preparati a partire per un viaggio mitico in compagnia dell'avventurosa e super smart topolina Pixi e del suo compagno, il gatto Sam. I due amici affronteranno le creature più stravaganti e pericolose della mitologia greca per aiutare il valoroso eroe Giasone e i suoi argonauti a salvare la città...

programme.title: Jack Il Primate Più Verticale 2
programme.desc: Dopo essere stato cacciato dalla squadra di hockey, Jack incontra Ben, uno skateboarder ambizioso. Ben scopre che Jack è molto abile con lo skateboard e i due decidono di partecipare a una competizione di skateboard in giro per il paese!

programme.title: Monster Hunter Stories: Ride On
programme.sub-title: S1:E7 Come la preparava la mamma
programme.desc: S1:E7 Come la preparava la mamma - Con i loro scherzi, i gemelli monelli Den-Den e Lin-Lin seminano il panico nel Villaggio di Hakum e si cacciano nei guai addentrandosi di notte nella foresta.

programme.title: Monster Hunter Stories: Ride On
programme.desc: S1:E8 Navirou innamorato - Miss Pink, una venditrice ambulante, si ferma al villaggio, e Navirou si innamora della sua assistente Felyne, Mocha. Quanto oltre si spingerà in nome dell'amore?

programme.title: Monster Hunter Stories: Ride On
programme.sub-title: S1:E9 Ads (l'Accordo di Dan e Silva)
programme.desc: S1:E9 Ads (l'Accordo di Dan e Silva) - Dan dubita di essere adatto a fare l'allenatore degli aspirati Rider e ripensa al suo vecchio amico Silva, che è sempre stato il migliore in tutto.

programme.title: Monster Hunter Stories: Ride On
programme.desc: S1:E10 Presagio di un disastro - Al villaggio arriva un pessimo presagio, il vento solitamente benevolo diventa violento. Hyoro fatica a non deludere le aspettative del suo esigente fratello Genie.

programme.title: Il prete sposato
programme.desc: Un giovane prete da poco arrivato in Sicilia si ritrova catapultato nelle spregiudicatezze locali, rivelategli in confessionale, soprattutto dalle donne. A causa di queste continue tentazioni, la sua fede inizia a vacillare. Le cose non migliorano affatto quando Silvia, una prostituta di paese, si presenta in confessionale e settimanalmente gli elenca i suoi "peccati".

programme.title: Lo sciupafemmine
programme.desc: Peppino, italiano in Brasile, lavora nella ditta del cugino Carlo, prossima al fallimento. Solo un imprenditore tedesco, Lacter, potrebbe salvare l'azienda, così Peppino paga una prostituta perché seduca Lacter fingendo di essere Lucia, la moglie di Carlo. Ma il tedesco ha in realtà già conosciuto Lucia, dando inizio a una spassosa girandola di equivoci.

programme.title: La polizia sta a guardare
programme.desc: Brescia. Il funzionario di polizia Cardone è chiamato a sostituire il questore Jovine che, impossibilitato a combattere la criminalità con i mezzi consentiti dalla legge, ha preferito dimettersi.

programme.title: La polizia ordina: sparate a vista
programme.desc: Il gangster Davis intende rubare, a Istanbul, due preziosissimi Budda, uno di proprietà di un collezionista, l'altro di un museo. Col collezionista gli va bene, ma al museo, invece, non ha fortuna. La polizia, avvertita da una spia, l'attende al varco.

programme.title: La vedovella
programme.desc: Susy, una ragazza squillo di Milano, riceve in regalo da un suo vecchio cliente, il Barone Colletta di Sant'Omero, un castello. Arrivata sul posto, viene scambiata per la vedova del defunto signorotto e viene immediatamente circuita dal sindaco, dai componenti della giunta comunale e da altre persone che aspirano tutte ad impadronirsi con pochi soldi della proprietà.

programme.title: Il carabiniere a cavallo
programme.desc: Spassosa commedia con Nino Manfredi e Annette Stroyberg. Il carabiniere Bartolomucci vuole sposare in segreto la sua fidanzata visto che il regolamento accademico gli proibisce di farlo prima di aver compiuto 15 anni di servizio. Ma proprio alla vigilia delle nozze, qualcuno gli ruba il cavallo. Nel giorno del suo matrimonio, il carabiniere farà di tutto per trovarlo. Diretta da Carlo Lizzani.

programme.title: Guardatele ma non toccatele
programme.desc: Un aereo militare con venti uomini a bordo deve atterrare in seguito ad avaria al motore. Il comandante del campo chiama a rapporto il maresciallo La Notte ed ordina che ai militari americani in arrivo sia assegnata la camerata degli avieri. L'ordine provoca scontento, che si trasforma in gioia quando dall'aereo americano scendono venti avvenenti ausiliarie, capitanate da Rebecca O'Connor.

programme.title: I Cadetti di Guascogna
programme.desc: Bellissima commedia piena di divertenti equivoci con Walter Chiari e Ugo Tognazzi. Walter e Ugo hanno un debole per la bella Vittoria, ma il padre, che nulla vuole saperne, spedisce la ragazza a Bracciano, dalla zia. Caso vuole, però, che entrambi i pretendenti ricevano una chiamata che li destina proprio sulle rive del lago laziale dove, incontrata la dolce fanciulla, accade una cosa imprevista.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News
programme.desc: Hot Corn Cine News è un appuntamento bisettimanale, nato dall'unione tra LoveTv Channel e The Hot Corn, che racconta tutte le novità del mondo del cinema, tra ospiti, eventi e interviste, prossime uscite in sala e cronache mondane. Ad introdurci in questo mondo di news sulla Settima Arte c'è Sara Scarsella. I cinque nuovi film in concorso a Venezia Johnny Depp sarà Ebenezer Scrooge nel nuovo film Scrooge e gli spiriti del Natale Ryan Gosling sarà il nuovo Ghost Rider intervista al regista Nicola Ragone Tom Holland si prepara a interpretare Fred Astaire. In chiusura, interviste dal Marateale a Massimiliano Caiazzo, Dario Aita e alla vincitrice del contest Young Blood, Aisha Meki.

programme.title: I nostri mariti
programme.desc: Tre episodi diretti da tre registi d'eccezione come Luigi Filippo D'Amico, Dino Risi e Luigi Zampa che raccontano una storia d'amore fuori da ogni schema, un'eredità difficile da ottenere e un adulterio facilitato dal carcere.

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: Revanche
programme.desc: L'ex criminale Alex e la sua fidanzata, la prostituta Tamara cercano disperatamente di sfuggire all'ambiente corrotto in cui vivono a Vienna, ma per farlo hanno bisogno di molti soldi. Alex ha un piano: rapinare una banca in un paesino di campagna. Tamara insiste per andare con lui e il ragazzo acconsente con riluttanza. Tutto va esattamente come previsto finché si avvicina Robert, un poliziotto felicemente sposato che vive in una fattoria vicino.

programme.title: Spore
programme.desc: Due amiche disegnatrici di fumetti, uno stupro, un omicidio per vendetta, una fuga. Sullo sfondo gli anni Ottanta, quelli delle fanzine e del punk, del referendum contro il nucleare e di una provincia sempre troppo stretta.

programme.title: The Constant Gardener
programme.desc: Quando sua moglie Tessa viene trovata morta in Kenya, il diplomatico Justin Quayle inizia a indagare, scoprendo una rete di corruzione e segreti pericolosi. Tra intrighi politici e complotti farmaceutici, la sua ricerca della verità metterà a rischio la sua stessa vita.

programme.title: Omicidio!
programme.desc: Un'affascinante donna, aspirante attrice, viene accusata di omicidio. Uno dei giurati incaricati di deliberare sul suo caso crede nella sua innocenza e inizia ad investigare per identificare il vero assassino.

programme.title: Final Portrait
programme.desc: Nel 1964, durante un breve viaggio a Parigi, lo scrittore americano e appassionato d'arte James Lord incontra il suo amico Alberto Giacometti, un pittore di fama internazionale, che gli chiede di posare per lui. Le sedute, gli assicura Giacometti, dureranno solo qualche giorno. Lusingato e incuriosito, Lord accetta. Non è solo l'inizio di un'amicizia insolita e toccante, ma anche di un viaggio illuminante nella bellezza, la frustrazione, la profondità e, a volte, il vero e proprio caos del processo artistico.

programme.title: BASTA DIRE Sì
programme.desc: La vita di Michelle è in declino: è stata licenziata e mollata lo stesso giorno. La sua migliore amica Sara, la convince a partecipare a un ritiro benessere dove deve solo "dire di sì" . Lì, però, col suo mentore Josh nasce una chimica inaspettata…

programme.title: UN AMORE MALATO
programme.desc: Una fotografa sviluppa un'ossessione che mette a rischio relazioni e sicurezza personale.

programme.title: PRIGIONIERA DELLA CASA
programme.desc: Riley vuole ricostruire il rapporto con sua madre e la sorellina, che vivono isolate a causa della malattia della sorella. Quando Riley capisce che la sorella potrebbe non essere malata, la madre farà di tutto per tenere con sé le sue figlie per sempre.

programme.title: Mood Indigo
programme.desc: Dal regista premio Oscar di “Se Mi Lasci Ti cancello”, una poetica e surreale storia d'amore con Omar Sy (Quasi Amici) e Audrey Tautou. Colin, un facoltoso parigino, si innamora di Chloé che è l'incarnazione di un brano di Duke Ellington. I due si sposano, ma, durante la luna di miele, Chloé si ammala. Colin deve lavorare tantissimo per l'unica cura che tiene in vita la moglie: fiori freschi.

programme.title: Darling Companion
programme.desc: Una mattina Beth salva un cane randagio e, nonostante il parere contrario del marito Joseph, decide di tenerlo con sé instaurandovi un legame speciale per compensare la solitudine della propria vita matrimoniale. Con Diane Keaton.

programme.title: Casino Jack
programme.desc: Jack Abramoff, potentissimo uomo d'affari e lobbista, è coinvolto in un gigantesco caso di corruzione tale da far tremare anche la Casa Bianca.

programme.title: Racconti Romani
programme.desc: Uscito dal carcere di Regina Coeli, Alvaro riprende il suo ruolo di "leader" del quartiere. Una Roma di fine anni '50 nel classico con Totò, la splendida Silvana Pampanini e il grande Vittorio De Sica.

programme.title: LAssassinio Di Un Allibratore Cinese
programme.desc: Cosmo Vittelli, titolare di uno squallido cabaret, perde una enorme cifra al gioco, indebitandosi con il criminale Mort. Quest'ultimo gli offre la possibilità di ripagare il proprio debito eliminando un fastidioso allibratore protetto dalla mafia.

programme.title: La Tomba del Dragone
programme.desc: L'archeologo Travis Preston parte assieme al suo team per la Cina dopo alcune misteriorse segnalazioni di avvistamenti avvenute dagli impiegati di una compagnia petrolifera che sta trivellando nei dintorni di un giacimento.

programme.title: Jimmy Bobo
programme.desc: Un action movie adrenalinico con protagonisti Sylvester Stallone, Jason Momoa e Christian Slater in cui, dopo aver assistito alla morte dei rispettivi partner, un assassino di New Orleans e un detective di Washington si alleano per abbattere il nemico comune.

programme.title: Arma Micidiale
programme.desc: Angel viene scarcerato e si riunisce con il suo amico Rich che lo aiuta a contrabbandare armi, ma non si rendono conto che la polizia di Detroit e l'FBI stanno lavorando per sgominare il contrabbando.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Miss Julie
programme.desc: Una residenza di campagna in Irlanda intorno al 1880. Nel corso di una notte di mezza estate, in un clima di baldoria selvaggia e vincoli sociali allentati, la giovane Julie e John, cameriere di suo padre, ballano e bevono, si corteggiano e manipolano.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: June again
programme.desc: Colpita da un disturbo cognitivo, June vive da anni in una casa di cura quando, all'improvviso, riacquista lucidità. Convinta che siano passati solo pochi mesi, torna dalla famiglia e scopre i figli Ginny e Devon allo sbando e l'azienda in crisi. Sapendo che il tempo è poco, prova a rimettere tutto in ordine. Ma tra errori e seconde possibilità, capirà di avere bisogno proprio di loro.

programme.title: Un amore da ricordare
programme.desc: Tenley, un'orticoltrice, trova il coraggio di incontrare la sua cotta online, Jared. Tenley viene scambiato per sua moglie ed è costretto a continuare a mentire con la famiglia di Jared e il suo affascinante migliore amico, Everett, per salvare la loro compagnia.

programme.title: Innamorarsi sul ghiaccio
programme.desc: Mary, proprietaria di una libreria di Denver, e Adam, giocatore professionista di una squadra di hockey, si rivolgono alla stessa agenzia di pubbliche relazioni per migliorare la propria immagine e lo stile di comunicazione. Ben presto si rendono conto che, come spesso accade in amore, gli opposti si attraggono.

programme.title: Sotto il segno dell'amore
programme.desc: Kelsey lavora per una rivista e per scrivere un articolo sulla visione scettica dell'amore e degli oroscopi collabora con Carter, un maestro dell'astrologia. Nonostante provengano da mondi opposti, i due scoprono che l'amore può davvero essere scritto nelle stelle.

programme.title: Il mio San Valentino
programme.desc: Dopo che il suo fidanzato l'ha lasciata il giorno di San Valentino, Piper, organizzatrice di proposte di matrimonio, ha perso la fiducia nelle relazioni amorose. Lavorando ad un nuovo ingaggio, la donna conosce Adam, il fratello del promesso sposo.

programme.title: Una festa da sogno
programme.desc: Kelly è una giovane, creativa e ambiziosa pianificatrice di eventi a New York e sta rapidamente guadagnando reputazione come una delle migliori nel settore. Ma quando Joe, un editore di siti web testardo, difficile ma influente, la assume per organizzare il compleanno della nipote di 10 anni, Kelly si rende rapidamente conto di aver appena incontrato il suo match.

programme.title: Dance off: sfida a ritmo di danza
programme.desc: Due squadre di danza rivali della stessa città si affrontano per il Campionato Nazionale.

programme.title: Il progetto del cuore
programme.desc: La timida artista Isla resta sconvolta quando il suo dipinto viene venduto per errore al carismatico venditore Mark, il cui capo vuole commissionarle una scultura. Con l'incoraggiamento di Mark, la fiducia di Isla cresce… e anche il loro amore.

programme.title: D'amore e d'accordo
programme.desc: Poppy è una specialista di marketing la cui vita viene sconvolta quando finge un fidanzamento con Milo, l'affascinante nuovo cliente del suo capo, per conquistare il severo amministratore del palazzo e ottenere per Milo l'attico.

programme.title: Elvis & Anabelle
programme.desc: Spinta dalla fanatica madre, Anabelle è il lizza per la vittoria della corona di Miss Texas, quando muore durante il concorso. Finisce così in obitorio, dove lavora Elvis, un imbalsamatore il cui forte amore per il padre malato gli impedisce di coltivare i propri sogni.

programme.title: Dopo l'uragano
programme.desc: La vita di un giovanissimo cuoco viene travolta dall'arrivo dell'uragano Sandy nel 2012.

programme.title: Il segreto delle Api
programme.desc: La dottoressa Jean Markham torna nella città che aveva lasciato da adolescente per occuparsi dello studio del padre.

programme.title: Becoming Jane
programme.sub-title: Il ritratto di una donna contro
programme.desc: Jane Austen è una ventenne romantica e indipendente nell'Inghilterra del 1795. Jane sogna un matrimonio d'amore mentre sua madre è ansiosa di accasarla con un aristocratico facoltoso. L'arrivo di Tom Lefroy, affascinante ma privo di mezzi, sconvolgerà gli equilibri della piccola comunità locale.

programme.title: Girl on the Edge
programme.desc: In seguito a un evento traumatico, l'adolescente Hannah inizia a intraprendere un percorso di autodistruzione. I genitori decidono di mandarla in un centro alternativo di guarigione per curarla.

programme.title: D-Day
programme.desc: War movie ad alta tensione con Randy Couture. D-Day, un'unità d'élite americana è incaricata di distruggere i cannoni nazisti a Pointe du Hoc. L'attacco alle imbarcazioni scatena una serie di eventi costringerà i soldati a combattere per giorni contro le forze tedesche.

programme.title: Lost River
programme.desc: Billy è una madre single con due figli che vive nella città di Lost River, un luogo decadente e privo di speranze. Non sapendo più come tirare avanti, la donna accetta un lavoro in uno strano club di burlesque.

programme.title: Fukushima
programme.desc: Giappone, 11 marzo 2011. L'intero paese è scosso da un terribile terremoto che causa danni immensi. Lo smottamento della terra, infatti, scatena un violentissimo tsunami che si abbatte sulle coste del paese lasciandosi dietro migliaia di morti.

programme.title: Un bambino per due
programme.desc: Trovandosi con il bambino di un ammiratore tra le mani, la conduttrice di un programma televisivo mattutino e il suo collega si scoprono innamorati mentre si prendono cura del piccolo insieme.

programme.title: Due cuori e una baita
programme.desc: La stacanovista Jillian vuole vendere una baita di montagna, ma il bel custode Liam le fa un'offerta. Volano scintille quando trasformano la baita in un resort. Ma quando gli affari non vanno secondo i piani, Jillian rinuncerà a tutto per amore?

programme.title: 10 Cose Da Fare Prima Di Lasciarsi
programme.desc: Ben e Abigail si conoscono a un appuntamento al buio in un bar e, per gioco, stilano una lista delle dieci cose da fare insieme prima di lasciarsi. Dopo aver passato la notte insieme, le cose prendono una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Finché giudice non ci separi
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto e Mauro sono quattro amici, tutti separati e accomunati dal rancore verso il giudice che ha seguito le loro separazioni. Situazioni paradossali e sorprese sempre dietro l'angolo, in una commedia divertentissima.

programme.desc: Tenley trova finalmente il coraggio di incontrare dal vivo Jared, conosciuto online un anno prima. Quando questi ha un incidente, l'ospedale fa firmare i documenti a Tenley, facendo credere alla famiglia di Jared che i due siano sposati.
